model: Hamilton Khaki Aviation Pilot Pioneer Auto H76255810
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Plan sizes from the trace of the straight front photo (38 mm outer bezel, listing; lug gap 18.20 mm measured against 18 mm listed). Heights before the house depth scale (11.4 mm thick listing). House method: modelled brushed case and lugs, polished coin-edge bezel and onion crown, modelled black leaf hour, baton minute and needle seconds hands with lume; photo maps only for the dial with the green bezel insert, and for the leather strap.

case.note: brushed middle case ring: its flank is the outer silhouette at 9 o'clock (the anchor), just outside the bezel teeth (no crown guards)

lug.note: outline from the trace (mean of the four lugs); brushed top sloping to the tip, polished edges

bezel.note: 120 fine teeth over a dark skirt, polished flat to the green insert; insert photo-mapped

dial.note: flat cream dial with the printed numerals and railroad track, short wall up to the crystal ring

hands.note: black hands (photo: black frames with light edge highlights): leaf hour hand with a spine, baton minute hand with three lume panels, needle seconds hand with a lozenge counterweight

crown.note: onion crown: neck at the bezel, cone out to 7.1 mm, fluted barrel, rounded end (trace profile)

strap.note: green leather, 17.7 mm (photo), house curl (SUR419P1): bend at the lug tips, 7 mm radius, end = tip + 2.2 x radius; each side samples the photo's straight strap (keepers included) with the lug tips aligned

steel_polished.note: house polished steel: bezel, crown, index frames, hands, bevels

steel_brushed.note: house brushed steel: case, lugs, crown guards

bezel_shadow.note: inside of the fine bezel notches (lighter than the Scuba's: the photo's coin edge reads light)

review.subtitle: Brushed steel case, eggshell dial with Arabic numerals, moss green bezel, green leather strap. Front relief GLB.
notes: House method: case, lugs, coin-edge bezel and onion crown are modelled in the house steel; the hands are modelled in glossy black with lume, as in the photo. The photo is used only for the dial print, the green bezel insert and the leather strap.
The numerals and the railroad minute track are printed flat on the dial.
The strap keepers come from the photo. The strap curls under at both ends, like the other tracker watches; the buckle is left out.
